environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; chunky, geometric leaf patterns; needles have a soft, succulent, rounded appearance; high-fidelity bark textures with a slightly weathered, chalky patina; focus on the unique silhouette of arid-adapted conifers.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range heroic shot of a solitary Cheirolepidiaceae conifer. Its branches are heavy with scale-like foliage, casting a long, soft shadow across the cracked silt of the playa floor.
visual_logic.ground: Dusty rose and ochre silt with visible mud-crack geometry and patches of white salt crystals.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; intense midday sun creating high-contrast volume on the tree's cylindrical branches and a bright, airy atmosphere.
